basic_info.description: NOPA duplex with sunny south facing yard and deck with views of Buena Vista Park and Sutro Tower. Built in 1910 the property retains it original charm - Bay windows, oak hardwood floors, decorative fireplace. Both units have south facing eat-in kitchens. Large storage space accessible from yard level.     Close to restaurants, cafs, grocery shopping, and city entertainment - Early to Rise, Matching Half Caf, Falletti Foods, Nopalito, Che Fico, The Mill, The Independent, NOPA Restaurant, Bi-Rite Market, Horsefeather, Koret Health and Recreation Center. The Panhandle, Alamo Park, and GG Park.     Lower flat is 2BR + office. This unit will be delivered vacant. Refreshed kitchen and bath, refinished floors, recently painted. Upper flat is tenant occupied (protected tenant) and will be delivered subject to tenant's rights. Rent is $1,453.36
